summary: Disaster Desk, Monday (hooks): added 5 Short topics from breakouts with final official reports (Calabasas S-76B, Convair 240, Long-EZ, Hudson 1549, Chernobyl) and put the owner's stakes-first hook on the weekly loop's list as the top first-second challenger.
why: The Shorts feed had one usable topic (FedEx 80). The owner's 22 Nov note asked for a hook that leads with the stakes, and the three breakouts in our shot sheets (1.91M, 7.4M, 2.56M) all open on the scale in the first sentence, while ours open on a plain question. No data of our own yet (0 videos with 48 h numbers).

findings.title: Breakouts open on the scale, not a question
findings.detail: Inside Decoded's 1.91M Short speaks 'a jet fell more than 26,000 feet' at 1 s; Athena_Explains' 7.4M names the 167 saved at 1 s. Now challenger dd-stakes-first-hook.

findings.title: Famous-flight reconstructions are the niche's biggest settled-event Shorts
findings.detail: Flight Simulator (158K subs): Kobe Bryant's flight 10.8M, Lynyrd Skynyrd 2.46M, John Denver 2.12M, Sully 679K. Each has a final NTSB report, so each is now a topic told from the report.

findings.title: FAA nationwide ground stop of 13 Nov: cause still open
findings.detail: A telecommunications failure at the en-route centres with no official finding yet, so no Short until there is one.

findings.title: Learjet ERA27MA026 preliminary not out
findings.detail: NTSB's last update 9 Nov; due about 1 Dec. Still on the watch list.
